tables.name: building
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE building (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, height REAL NOT NULL)

tables.name: room
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE room (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, building_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES building(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal >= 0), name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT, image BLOB)

tables.name: empty_entity
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE empty_entity (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL)

query: SELECT b.name AS building, r.name AS room, r.ordinal FROM building b JOIN room r ON r.building_id = b.id ORDER BY r.ordinal
